prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Rasta Quest distant forest BACKGROUND panorama, independently authored, not a concept board. Reference image1 is direction only: ancient damaged green forest and ruins. Create a polished pixel-art landscape panorama 16:9. Muted deep teal/olive silhouettes of distant giant tree trunks, overlapping canopy and a pale desaturated mist opening in center. Clear separation into distant masses, deliberate crisp pixel clusters, low contrast behind gameplay. No ground/platforms, no close tree framing, no foreground shrubs, no characters, no weapons, no portal, no text/grid/labels. Bottom third is quiet fog with almost no contrast to keep combat legible. Medieval forest with damaged vegetation and only tiny hints of stone far away; no bright magenta or glowing cyan effects, no religious symbols. Edge foliage arrangement should support repetition but do not fake a seamless guarantee. Flat orthographic 2D side-view background, not isometric, no perspective floor.
prompts.modules: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Rasta Quest forest MIDGROUND/PROP authoring kit, separate transparent asset sheet. Reference image1 direction only; preserve old green forest/ruin look without cropping its examples. Create a transparent landscape 3x2 sheet of six isolated modules: top-left single tall broad ancient tree trunk with moss/canopy tips and roots; top-middle broken mossy medieval stone column; top-right low fallen log with moss. Bottom-left small dark foreground fern cluster leaning right; bottom-middle matching fern cluster leaning left; bottom-right small rubble/mushroom cluster. No floor, ground stripe, sky, labels/grid or background. Muted earthy green/umber/slate, no neon/cyan/magenta light, no runes/religious marks. Premium clean pixel-art texture and clustered lighting, readable at small size. Broad transparent gutters, entire silhouette in each equal cell, no overlap, actual alpha background. Trunk highest at128 world units, column96, log32, ferns48, rubble32: relative scale of sheet objects need not match, they will be explicitly reconstructed separately. Orthographic2D side-view, no isometric floor.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single Rasta Quest seamless-style32x32 grass/soil PLATFORM TILE authoring source. One square opaque texture study filling entire image. Orthographic2D SIDE VIEW cross-section, never top-down/isometric. A straight thin moss/grass top boundary across full upper edge at exact same height, no hills, no trees, no flowers/stones rising above surface. Upper fifth tightly clustered forest grass/roots; lower four fifths dark rich soil and small angular gray stones with a few brown root lines, enough contrast to read walkable top. Premium pixel-art clusters at32px intended native target, not a tiny checkerboard pattern. Both left/right edges continue grass/soil at same level; no border/padding/shadow/labels/grid. Muted olive highlights, dark brown/green/charcoal soil, no glowing crystals, purple/cyan/red magic. Based on reference forest material direction, not cropping or duplicating its concept tiles. One simple continuous tile face, no spritesheet, no perspective.
prompts.chaser: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest Chaser/Knight first six-state animation BODY+equipment authoring sheet. Reference is identity/style only, not a frame to crop. Create one transparent 4-column2-row sheet of EIGHT isolated complete poses in this exact reading order: idle, move-left contactA, move-left contactB, anticipation with sword lifted; second row attack-left high, attack-left follow-through, hurt-recoil, final fallen-dead on side. Same armored knight throughout: closed charcoal medieval helmet with narrow slit, broad battered gray pauldrons, angular dark armor, ragged crimson waist cloth/cape, a compact broad sword in near hand and angular shield in far hand, tiny restrained crimson cracks. No visible skin, hair, antlers, crosses, religious iconography, runes or new symbols. All active poses face LEFT, profile/slight three-quarter consistent, no back view. Fixed same anatomical drawing scale/head size across all8cells INCLUDING horizontal final death (do not enlarge the fallen figure). Same armor silhouette, sword length and shield shape; full hairless helmet to soles visible with transparent gutters. Same ground baseline per row for standing poses, clear bent limbs in move; dead body fully inside last cell. Polished deliberate pixel-art clusters, not blocky placeholder or painterly blur. Compact short sword not axe/scythe, shield cannot grow or change between poses. No effects/trails/background/ground shadows/text. Eight coherent keys, genuinely transparent background. Initial prototypes for six states; no licensing/acceptance text.
